status: Release 4.3.6 done. B2 frame fix shipped: (a) FRAME_ROTATION_VS_GEOMETRY is now INFO (contract: matrix_4x4 = local->world, bbox_mm/geometry = world_mm, never apply the matrix to world data), (b) Group#bounds is parent-space in SketchUp, so exporter world_bounds now carries it through parent_world - nested rotated groups get a true world AABB (spec fixture: nested_rot under a 90 deg parent), (c) gate skips mesh-vs-bbox verdicts for containers (bbox = union of children, geometry = direct only) and reports FRAME_UNDECIDABLE instead. notes.extension_installed: Plugins: cad2llm_exporter.rb 4.2.1 + lib/exporter.rb (definition_description), annotate.rb, bridge.rb, html/inspector.html; SHA256 shodne se src.
notes.apply_drift_guard: Bridge apply: pre_check -> snapshot (<token dir>/snapshots/<stamp>_<slug>.json) -> apply -> geometry_drift(pre, post) s toleranci GEOMETRY_TOL_MM = 0.001; pri driftu undo (single=1, jinak pocet applied) a report nese rolled_back=true, rollback_reason, rollback_undo_steps. export RPC umi inline=true (bez zapisu).
notes.verify_cli: cad2llm_bridge.py verify --baseline B [--current C | --live] [--fields a,b]; exit 0 clean / 3 drift / 2 usage. DEFAULT_FIELDS: name, tag, definition_name, definition_description, metadata.cad2llm.role, metadata.cad2llm.zone, metadata.ifc.type.
notes.derive_tool: tools/cad2llm_derive.py: role = existujici metadata -> tag_roles -> v5.classify; zapisuje jen rozdily; --names prejmenuje genericka/jine nez [A-Za-z0-9_.-] jmena na <role>_NN; --descriptions sablona '<label_cs> · zona <zone> · <ifc>' (existing popis se neprepisuje bez --overwrite); --overwrite; set_description dedupovano per definice; vystup annotate_plan/v1 (transaction single).
notes.project_metadata: target.kind='model' povoluje jen set_attribute; model target -> uid='model'. Exporter uklada project_metadata.metadata = metadata_of(model, skip: SKIP_DICT_EXACT + ['GeoReference','GSU_ContributorsInfo','temp']). IfcGUIDs zustava. Priklad planu: docs/plans/project_metadata_example.json (hodnoty jsou placeholder, neaplikovano).
notes.vocab_shared: tools/cad2llm_rules.json -> vocab {version, zones, roles:{system,zone,ifc,label_cs}, tag_roles}; tools/cad2llm_vocab.py check_node -> UNKNOWN_ROLE/UNKNOWN_ZONE/IFC_ROLE_MISMATCH/TAG_ROLE_MISMATCH; cad2llm_core.validate pridava vocab issue pro kazdy uzel (i bez bboxu); v5.classify je metadata-first (CLASS_A, confidence 0.95, evidence R_METADATA_ROLE/R_METADATA_ZONE).

notes.geometry_export_2026_10_23: export_profile spatial|geometry; geometry block is direct-only, world mm, deterministic vertices/edges/faces; volume only when closed+oriented and no holes; legacy v3 export retired, Python read-only v3 remains.
notes.legacy_v3: CAD2LLM.export_v3, LEGACY_VERSION and menu item removed. Old v3 JSON is still accepted by tools/cad2llm.py validate for migration only.
notes.slim: tools/cad2llm_slim.py is the current CLI; default drops geometry; standalone supports stdin/stdout, --compact, --dry-run, --print-stats, rotation/domain flags. cad2llm.py slim currently exposes only --geometry and --compact.
notes.enrich_open_bugs: A: energy hardcoded null; B: clearance regex broken after stove rename (role-based rules preferred); C: free_space fallback wrong without role=floor; D: space_boundary pollutes relations (11/48 on v1.2).
notes.gui_compact: GUI compact is a serialization mode only (JSON.generate vs pretty); content identical to pretty export. Compact suffix _compact.json. Slim remains the Python-side transform for further reduction.
notes.tag_audit: Read-only audit. Exporter.audit_tags is the single core used by bridge tag_audit, GUI menu and export validation.tag_consistency. inner_tags = Face/Edge directly in the definition; nested_tags = nested Group/ComponentInstance; model root is separate.
notes.tag_normalize: Dry-run default; apply requires dry_run:false / CLI --apply. Target is the single instance tag; multiple instance tags => ambiguous. Applied on v1.3: 356 entities, 0 nested, 0 ambiguous, one undoable operation.
notes.skp_primary_model_state: Tag normalization applied in memory (356 entities); model is modified but NOT saved. Author must Ctrl+S before relying on the file.
notes.export_tag_check: Implemented in 4.3.5. validation.tag_consistency is advisory, additive, and not part of validation.issues. Detailed per-instance drill-down stays in tag_audit RPC. GUI always on; API opt-out tag_audit:false / CLI --no-tag-audit.
